description: DIFC employment contract (Meridian Capital Advisors). The demo coverage matrix also claimed UAE Labour Law breaches; federal labour law and the federal PDPL do not apply in the DIFC, so those are labelled must-not-flag here

expected.why: Probation of 9 months exceeds 6; 3 days notice below 7
50 hours a week exceeds 40; unpaid additional hours
End-of-service lump sum instead of DEWS contributions
15 working days of leave (20 required); forfeited at year end
14 days notice regardless of service; 30 or 90 required
Unrestricted worldwide transfer of employee data, no rights or safeguards

acceptable.why: Equal opportunity clause without a non-discrimination commitment
Written statement lacks sick leave provisions

mustNotFlag.why: DIFC employer: federal labour law does not apply in the DIFC
DIFC employer: DMCC rules do not apply
DIFC has its own data protection law; the federal PDPL does not apply
